name: Aomi Task API (Arc Mainnet)
description: Production Arc Mainnet service that prepares and simulates an unsigned execution bundle. A valid JSON POST quotes a 0.01 USDC body-bound x402 preparation purchase through Circle Gateway. Status polling is free; the frozen result requires a separate purchase priced at 3% of simulated gross outgoing USDC, and zero outflow is free. Aomi does not sign or execute the transaction.
